exposure: Mifepristone and Misoprostol combination for labour induction
Foley balloon and Misoprostol combination for labour induction
outcome: Neonatal morbidity (on the first and fifth minute of life)
cohort: The study included 175 pregnant women, aged 21-35, with gestational age 37-42 weeks, undergoing labour induction.
finding: The Mifepristone-Misoprostol combination offers advantages over the Foley balloon-Misoprostol combination for labour induction, including reduced pain intensity, shorter labour duration, and prevention of cervical laceration.
mod_finding: The Mifepristone-Misoprostol group had a higher rate of vaginal delivery and a lower frequency of cesarean section compared to the Foley balloon-Misoprostol group.
followup_time: Fifth minute of life (for neonatal morbidity)
